summary: Created an XFS logical volume at /srv/data, grew it online from 1.00 GiB to 2.15 GiB, preserved its contents, configured persistent boot activation, and verified recovery after reboot.
actions_performed: Created data_vg/data_lv and mounted it at /srv/data.
Added a payload and recorded its SHA-256 before growth.
Added a second PV and extended the mounted LV and XFS filesystem online to 2.15 GiB.
Configured persistent loop-PV attachment and /etc/fstab mounting.
Restarted node1 and verified a changed boot ID, recovered storage, and intact data.

evidence.summary: Shows /srv/data backed by /dev/mapper/data_vg-data_lv with XFS, both before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
evidence.summary: The LV began at 1.00 GiB with payload hash 4a1dcf…a7a9; lvextend/xfs_growfs enlarged it online to 2.15 GiB while mounted, with the identical hash afterward.
Shows the loop setup service enabled and active, fstab-compatible mount validation, and /srv/data mounted.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 0305efed-2c0e-4265-b609-10e8259d59a7; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 8572da81-de11-40c8-95ac-ad340fc8a6a8; system health, loop PVs, active 2.15 GiB LV, mount, and payload hash all recovered.
